theorems.name: Submission.ts_pdb_linear_range_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ) (j : ℝ), 0 ≤ j → (∀ S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (A '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal j * volume S) → ∀ f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), ∫ y in (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), f y ∂μHE[n] = j * ∫ u, f (A u)
